entry.name: 捐毒
entry.area: 乌恰县西部／伊尔克什坦附近候选区域
entry.note: 王治记为衍敦谷，具体位置尚未核实。本次采用伊尔克什坦附近、克孜勒苏河上游候选地望，以一位小数的区域示意点表示；不是口岸建筑、城址或国界范围。另有乌恰西北、乌鲁克恰提（老乌恰）及阿赖谷地等说法，不能将其与现代乌恰县城直接等同。《汉书》记居民随水草而居，暂未找到可核对的捐毒城墙矢量。
entry.noteEn: Yandun Valley is recorded as the royal seat, but its exact location is unverified. The marker follows the proposed Irkeshtam / upper Qizil Su region and is deliberately rounded to one decimal place. It is neither a surveyed city nor a border/port boundary. Northwestern Ulugqat, old Ulugqat and the Alai Valley are alternative proposals. No verified city-wall geometry has been found.
